Fire.notes: Open jaw and committed thrust at f34; visible sweep through f84. Play trims at 1x; preserve pre-ignition windup VFX, turn flame off at recovery.

Bite.notes: Lunge starts f12 and jaw closes f18; active includes f20-31 shake. One damage contact per attack remains current policy.

Flight.notes: Takeoff/land endpoints authored against Hover v1 frame0. r2 has different tucked pose; require checked transition if used. Do not add old 1400cm actor sine altitude on top of 302cm authored root altitude.

locomotion.notes: Turn is nonlooping with actual yaw plus pivot translation. Neither /20 degree cycling nor actor yaw plus unstripped authored yaw preserves it. Derive actor root transform from native converted root, or strip that root and apply equivalent curve to actor; account for component scale and offset. A right turn needs an explicitly mirrored/reversed integration derivative, not the unmodified left turn aliased to both directions.
